findings.title: Source path resolved relative to cwd, not __file__
findings.problem: test_version_module_has_no_third_party_imports resolves the module under test with `Path("src/codemie/rest_api/a2a/version.py")`, a bare path relative to the process's current working directory, rather than anchoring to `__file__`.
findings.impact: When pytest is invoked with a cwd other than the repo root (IDE test runner, a CI step that cd's into a subdirectory), this raises FileNotFoundError instead of the intended import-check assertion failure, masking the real check and deviating from the anchoring pattern already used in 21 other test files in this repo.
findings.recommendation: Anchor the path to `__file__`, e.g. `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "src/codemie/rest_api/a2a/version.py"`, matching the project's established test convention for locating source files under test.

finding_status.notes: Source now computes repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] and reads repo_root/src/codemie/rest_api/a2a/version.py; verified this resolves to the real file on disk independent of process cwd.
